shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in app/ProductList.tsx app/UserProfile.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "===== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; git diff package.json
ls node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "node_modules present" || echo "no node_modules"; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
git status --short; git diff --stat tsconfig.json; git checkout -- tsconfig.json; echo "---after---"; git status --short
